verdicts.reason: The full disputed amount (Rs 962,480.68) is traced to this account via T004127854 and remains in the balance (tainted_out = 0), so the lien preserves identifiable victim funds. Although the account appears genuinely operated (4-year-old business account, 0.4% pass-through, 16 payers, no mule links), a genuine account can hold stolen money received in good faith, and the lien freezes only ~6.7%…
